Cologne Zoo has announced the birth of Yenai – a southern pudu, a species recognized as one of the world’s smallest deer. 

Born on May 15, the fawn is the offspring of mother Yadira, who arrived from Rotterdam Zoo, and father Alvess, who was born at Cologne Zoo four years ago.
translated_text:
科隆动物园宣布了耶奈 (Yenai) 的诞生，它是一种南方普渡鹿，被认为是世界上最小的鹿之一。 

这只小鹿出生于 5 月 15 日，母亲亚迪拉 (Yadira) 从鹿特丹动物园抵达，父亲阿尔维斯 (Alvess) 四年前在科隆动物园出生。
